description: Finish a two-stage geology sample work order. Phase 'intake': x['events'] lists [ticket,rev,zone,grams,status] in arbitrary order. At the highest revision for each ticket ignore exact duplicates. If distinct rows tie there, quarantine the ticket (even if one is void). Otherwise drop status 'void' and keep status 'ok'. Return {"kept":[[ticket,rev,zone,grams],...],"conflicts":[ticket,...]}, both sorted by ticket. Phase 'revise' runs after a restart with ONLY x['snapshot'] (your saved intake), x['exclude'] (one zone) and x['minimum'] (minimum retained ticket count per zone, inclusive). The revised request excludes that zone from reporting and omits groups below minimum. Return {"summary.csv": csv_text, "audit.json": json_text}. CSV header zone,count,grams, data by descending total grams then ascending zone, final newline. Audit is a JSON object with "conflicts" (the sorted quarantined ticket IDs) and "kept_count" (all initially kept tickets, before report exclusions). Empty CSV still has its header. Strings are ordinary ASCII labels. No filesystem calls; the runner commits the exact texts you return.
provenance: Recovered model-written intake and a model-written reporting phase repaired using public checks.
